purpose: Prevent external events from being marked done without evidence.
rules: No buyer event is complete without recorded evidence.
No delivery is complete without intake, output, QA and handoff evidence.
No public address purchase before functional product proof.

items.name: First pilot event
items.required_evidence: accepted scope, agreed price, sample data, delivery owner
items.fallback: internal dry run with sample data

items.name: Real delivery proof
items.required_evidence: intake, output, QA verdict, handoff, feedback
items.fallback: internal dry run using delivery registry

items.name: Public address
items.required_evidence: working product flow and release check
